Welcome toClimate City

View Master Plan

A city is more than the places we build.
It is the life we create together.

Climate City is a proposed smart, sustainable community in Nasarawa State, Nigeria, powered by MikoShell Limited. We are bringing homes, nature and opportunity together to make lower-carbon living part of everyday life.

About Climate City

Less resource use.
More everyday value.

Climate City proposes a connected neighbourhood where the design of homes, streets and utilities works together to reduce daily resource demand.

01

Daily needs within reach

Homes near schools, shops and care, linked by shaded walking and cycling routes. The aim: shorter journeys and less dependence on a car.

02

Infrastructure that works together

Solar power, efficient buildings and managed water systems are planned together, with demand reduction guiding each phase of development.

03

Nature as essential infrastructure

Native planting, connected habitats and site-appropriate drainage will guide a landscape designed to provide shade and manage stormwater.
